title: Extremely Loud Incorrect Buzzer
blurb: Being wrong is one thing; being informed of it at building-wide volume is a different experience entirely. This is the game-show buzzer weaponised: same shape, same descending honk of failure, with every ounce of restraint removed. It exists for confidently incorrect statements, terrible takes delivered with certainty, and the specific moment somebody opens with 'trust me on this'. The excessive volume is doing all of the comedy here, and the sound would simply not work at a reasonable level. Warn your headphone users. Or, on reflection, do not.
origin: The maximally loud edition of the game-show wrong-answer buzzer.
